sources.entry: ProjeQtOr - Complete, mature, multi-user project management system with extensive functionality for all phases of a project. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP

summary.name: ProjeQtOr
summary.one_liner: ProjeQtOr is a free, open source, multi-user project management system covering planning, tracking, collaboration, risks, and costs for waterfall, agile, and hybrid methodologies.
use_cases: Replace Excel spreadsheets for project tracking
Plan and track waterfall, agile, or hybrid projects
Manage shared resources across multiple projects
Run a self-hosted PMO on company servers
summary.what_it_does: ProjeQtOr combines planning, tracking, collaboration, risk, and cost management in one tool, aimed at operational teams and strategic portfolio views. It supports multiple project methodologies and includes features such as a work plan, planning with pools, critical resources, multiple baselines, skills, and portfolios. The page says it can manage hundreds of projects and thousands of activities. It can be self-hosted or used through SaaS hosting in France that can be converted to on-premise.
notable: Licensed AGPL-3.0 and described as free with no license fees
Planning with pools, critical resources, multiple baselines, and skills
Developed in France; self-hostable or French SaaS hosting
Over 15 years of development, with optional paid professional services
caveats: Professional services and SaaS hosting are optional paid offerings
Page does not specify system requirements or installation steps
